name: Virginia House of Delegates Page Program
org: Virginia House of Delegates, Clerk's Office
what_you_do: Work as a House Page for the whole 2027 legislative session in Richmond. Pages deliver documents and run errands. They help committees and the Clerk's Office. They also take part in leadership and civics training.
who_can_apply: Virginia youth who will be 13 or 14 years old on January 13, 2027. You must be in good school standing. Your school must agree to the long absence.
pay_detail: A paid position of about 40 hours a week. The program FAQ says pages get a weekly session expense payment (no taxes withheld) and a regular wage paid every two weeks (taxes withheld). Dollar amounts are not stated on the pages read.
duration: The 2027 session. The page says 7 weeks in odd-numbered years
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 session close Friday, Oct 16, 2026 at 3 p.m. Eastern. Selected pages are usually told by email before Thanksgiving.
how_to_apply: Use the online application portal linked on the Capitol Classroom Page Programs page. Verify your date of birth. Create an account. Finish every part of the application. Ask your principal, teachers and counselor first, since you will miss school. Questions: HousePageInfo@house.virginia.gov or (804) 698-1502.
notes: The Speaker of the House picks the pages. Pages live in a residential setting with other pages. They have a mandatory evening study hall. Incomplete applications are not considered, so check that your application shows as complete. This is a separate program from the Senate Page Program.
